rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a high-quality hatching/expanded blastocyst and appropriately characterizes strong ICM and TE, but it leans heavily on the provided Gardner score and includes specific localization/details that may not be fully verifiable from the image alone.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior live birth, male factor context, sperm parameters, and prior cycle history with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and mostly well supported, especially around embryo quality versus BMI effects; minor overstatements include calling age 36 clearly favorable and suggesting morphology meaningfully mitigates aneuploidy risk.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice, especially support for single embryo transfer with a good-quality day-5 blastocyst; slight limitations include incomplete discussion of age-related aneuploidy/PGT nuance and some speculative statements.
Provides useful practical advice such as SET and endometrial assessment, but the recommendations are truncated/incomplete and lack fuller transfer protocol or future-cycle planning detail.
